method: Located all 156 previously page-unverified Wave03 source details by exact normalized Italian phrase match against the supplied original 1900 PDF text layer (each source-page phrase matched exactly once), read contextual Italian paragraphs to correct misleading generic matches, and inspected visual contact sheets for all 49 distinct matched original PDF folios. Original printed folio from scan page running headings; PDF pages are one-based. Normalized anchor is a search locator rather than facsimile-verbatim quotation. No present-day, independent-author, rite or identity release gates promoted.
holds: Civic, folk and theatrical festival spectacle details are not auto-promoted as Catholic customs or contemporary liturgical practices.
Original Pitrè source page confirms Pitrè's 1900 report, not independent eyewitness corroboration or claimed miracles.
Scicli's brief for a 2am Mass remains unverified at papal original and same-author 1881 repeats are not independent.
Children strapped to Messina's former Bara, Scicli staged battle and Mazara animal games are historical accounts only, never recommendations.
Comiso civic faction disputes and staged encounter must not be represented as authorized ritual rubric.
Dates in nineteenth-century Sicilian practice are not certified as current Calendar event schedules.
